title: Defend: is_fips flag on provider enables hard FIPS filter in lookup
description: crypto2dev_registry.c / crypto2dev_provider.h — the is_fips field on struct crypto2dev_provider is a single-bit sentinel. When any provider with is_fips=1 is registered, fips_provider_count goes positive, and crypto2dev_lookup_algo() hard-filters all non-FIPS providers out of the search — they are invisible regardless of load order and regardless of whether the caller names a non-FIPS provider explicitly. A reviewer might suggest 'just let callers specify the provider by name, no need for a filter'. This is wrong: FIPS 140-3 requires that the validated boundary be the only active crypto path when the FIPS module is loaded. Allowing explicit bypass of the filter via a provider name string would break FIPS algorithm non-bypass (FCS requirement). The hard filter is non-negotiable. The is_fips flag avoids a two-pass lookup (first checking FIPS providers, then falling back) which would create a TOCTOU window.
close_reason: Code verified correct. Rationale comments present in source.
